whatsNew: The Android package version/build was incremented for this release.
Android now starts at an 80% WebView scale for a more compact layout, with pinch-to-zoom disabled and multi-touch no longer triggering the app's pull-to-refresh reload.
The bottom-center Home control is smaller and more refined, with a premium gold finish, illuminated edge, depth, halo, and circular logo clipping.
The Android startup experience now shows a larger full E-Football logo on a branded dark splash while the WebView loads.
The release metadata and What's New list are synchronized to the staged Android release and include the complete user-facing changes in this version.
